lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular matrix of high-luminance, circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately six horizontal rows posterior to the fifth gill slit, with centroid spacing increasing along the anterior-posterior axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal spot rows, creating a grid-like alignment where high-luminance blobs serve as nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single, prominent horizontal linear feature is visible along the dorsal-lateral margin, characterized by a sharp luminance transition (light upper, shadowed lower) indicative of a structural ridge.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinct, elongated, low-luminance fusiform object is visible in the ventral water column immediately posterior to the pectoral fin's trailing edge.
